meta.localEdits: Built from the repository by scripts/design-system/build.mjs (npm run guide:build). Edit the code and design-system/, then build and publish (design-system/PUBLISHING.md); edits made on the page are replaced by the next publish.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: titles, table cell text, input values. Light 16.4:1 on surface, 15.1:1 on canvas and subtle; dark 14.2:1 on surface, 11.9:1 on subtle-2.

tokens.name: color-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field labels, table headers, stat labels, inactive segmented options. 9.5:1 on surface, 8.8:1 on canvas, 8.4:1 on subtle-2, 8.6:1 on info-bg.

tokens.name: color-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, icons, placeholders, hints, inactive tabs, the select chevron. Light 5.27:1 on surface, 4.62:1 on subtle-2 (the lowest); dark 6.81:1 on surface, 5.68:1 on subtle-2. At least 4.5:1 on every fill in both themes.

tokens.name: color-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled text only (2.58:1 on surface, exempt from contrast rules). Never for readable labels.

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers, table rules. Decorative only: 1.24:1 on surface, 1.14:1 on canvas, so it never draws a control's edge.

tokens.name: color-line-strong
tokens.usage: The edge of every control: inputs, selects, date fields, filter boxes, unchecked checkboxes and radios, secondary and outline icon buttons; scrollbar thumb. Light 3.30:1 on surface, 3.05:1 on canvas; dark 3.76:1 on surface, 4.08:1 on canvas, 3.14:1 on subtle-2.

tokens.name: color-subtle
tokens.usage: Table header band, disabled control fill, secondary-button hover. Light: an alias of canvas (the two were 1.01:1 apart). Dark: its own step between canvas and subtle-2 (#18202c, = viewer-raised).

tokens.name: color-subtle-2
tokens.usage: Hover fills on ghost and icon buttons, segmented track, code chips, empty-state icon tile, skeleton placeholders.

tokens.name: color-canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind cards (body bg-canvas). In light, subtle reads the same value.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Print rules and the always-dark document viewer only (paper, the viewer's text). Does not change with the theme: panels use surface, text on a solid fill uses on-solid. Lint (ds/no-off-system-classes) rejects white elsewhere.

tokens.name: color-brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, checked checkboxes and radios, the active segmented option, selected toggle chips. Navy in light (on-solid 14.5:1); light blue #8db7f5 in dark with near-black on-solid text (9.2:1).

tokens.name: color-brand-2
tokens.usage: Primary-button and checked-box hover, active tab underline, strong brand text. 11.0:1 on surface.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Links, info icons and every focus ring (solid 2px). Light 6.09:1 on surface, 5.34:1 on subtle-2; dark #8db7f5, 8.4:1 on surface, 7.0:1 on subtle-2. color-info is an alias of it.

tokens.name: color-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent on always-dark chrome: the sign-in mark on the navy banner; links, focus rings and checked boxes in the PDF viewer (7.98:1 on viewer-raised). Fixed: the same in both themes.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Status: valid, current, complete. Text on success-bg 5.32:1. Green, amber and red only ever mean status.

tokens.name: color-success-bg
tokens.usage: Success status pill fill; success notice.

tokens.name: color-success-line
tokens.usage: Success status pill inset ring; success notice edge.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Status: due soon, expiring, needs attention. Text on warning-bg 5.00:1.

tokens.name: color-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning status pill fill; warning notice.

tokens.name: color-warning-line
tokens.usage: Warning status pill inset ring; warning notice edge.

tokens.name: color-warning-fill
tokens.usage: Solid amber marks only: readiness cells, progress bars, status dots. Light #c27803: 3.51:1 on surface, lighter than success and danger (1.67:1 and 1.87:1). Dark #b97d10: 4.95:1 on surface, darker than success and danger (1.82:1 and 1.75:1). Either way "due" is not told from them by hue alone. Never for text: text is warning.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Status: expired, missing, gap; destructive buttons; invalid field edges and error text. Text on danger-bg 5.87:1; white on danger 6.57:1. Only 1.12:1 lighter than success, so the two are told apart by hue: every status pill carries its symbol and its word.

tokens.name: color-danger-2
tokens.usage: Danger button hover. White on danger-2 8.66:1.

tokens.name: color-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Danger status pill fill; danger-ghost hover; danger notice.

tokens.name: color-danger-line
tokens.usage: Danger status pill inset ring; danger notice edge.

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.usage: Category tone: the filled info chip, info notices and icons. An alias of accent. Text on info-bg 5.46:1.

tokens.name: color-info-bg
tokens.usage: Info chip and notice fill; selected DataTable rows; checked card-variant checkboxes and radios.

tokens.name: color-info-line
tokens.usage: Info chip inset ring; info notice edge.

tokens.name: color-violet
tokens.usage: Category tone: the second non-status category. The violet chip is outlined, violet text on surface (6.83:1 light, 7.9:1 dark), so it differs from the filled info chip by more than hue.

tokens.name: color-violet-line
tokens.usage: Violet chip inset ring (decorative, 1.46:1 on surface; the text carries the chip).

tokens.name: color-viewer-deep
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: the page well behind the document.

tokens.name: color-viewer
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: panels and inputs.

tokens.name: color-viewer-raised
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: toolbars and sidebars. Only 1.06:1 from viewer, so viewer-line rules separate the two.

tokens.name: color-viewer-hover
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: hover on dark rows and buttons.

tokens.name: color-viewer-line
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: borders on dark (1.43:1 on viewer-raised, decorative only).

tokens.name: color-viewer-text
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: secondary text. 9.6:1 on viewer-raised.

tokens.name: color-viewer-muted
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: meta text and icons. 5.68:1 on viewer-hover, 6.44:1 on viewer-raised.

tokens.name: color-success-on-dark
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: success status on dark. 9.4:1 on viewer-raised.

tokens.name: color-warning-on-dark
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: warning status on dark. 9.8:1 on viewer-raised.

tokens.name: color-danger-on-dark
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: danger status on dark. 9.7:1 on viewer-raised.

tokens.name: color-black
tokens.usage: Paper-form rules on the printed authorisation card replica only (pinned light). Lint rejects black elsewhere.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, side sheets, popovers, menus, toasts, tooltips, inputs, selects, checkboxes and pinned table cells: the panel and control surface. White in light, #141b24 (= viewer) in dark. Replaces bg-white everywhere outside print and the viewer.

tokens.name: color-on-solid
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid brand, brand-2, accent, danger, danger-2 or success fill (primary and danger buttons, selected chips and segments, avatars, the count disc, check glyphs); an icon on warning-fill. White in light; near-black #0d1218 in dark, where those fills are pale. 9.2:1 on brand in dark, 14.5:1 in light.

tokens.name: color-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs, side sheets, the command palette and the mobile menu (bg-scrim). Light: ink at 40%; dark: black at 60%, so a dialog still lifts off a dark page.

tokens.name: color-viewer-primary
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: the primary button fill (Button dark). Fixed: the light accent, because accent turns pale in the dark theme and the viewer looks the same in both.

tokens.name: color-viewer-primary-hover
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: primary button hover (fixed, the light brand-2).

tokens.name: color-viewer-danger
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: the danger button fill (Button dark). Fixed, the light danger.

tokens.name: color-viewer-danger-hover
tokens.usage: PDF viewer: danger button hover (fixed, the light danger-2).

families.sans: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: statValue: the figure on a full stat tile, tabular-nums; ink, amber or red only while its count is above zero.

styles.name: stat-value-compact
styles.usage: statValueCompact: the figure on a compact tile, tabular-nums.

styles.name: modal-title
styles.usage: ModalShell title, ink, truncates to one line.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: sectionTitle: one per card or section, ink.

styles.name: body-14
styles.usage: statLabel and the empty-state title; ink-2.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Licence B1.1 issued by HCAA, valid until 14 Mar 2027.
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, inputs, buttons (medium), modal subtitles.

styles.name: body-comfortable
styles.usage: Replaces body (13px) in comfortable density: table cells, inputs, buttons.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: tableHead on a subtle band, ink-2, never wraps.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: metaLine under a row's main text, muted, items split by a dot.

styles.name: status-pill
styles.usage: StatusBadge width="column" (and StatusSelect's pill): the 120px status in a requirement row's Status column.

styles.name: status-badge
styles.usage: StatusBadge: every inline status label, rounded-full; success, warning and danger carry their symbol.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Badge: category chips and counts (neutral, info, violet, brand), radius-md. Never a status.

styles.name: code-chip
styles.usage: codeChip: regulator and record codes on subtle-2, ink-2, never a status colour.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: text-10: the printed authorisation card only (a paper-form replica), below the 11px screen floor. Never on screen.

spacing.note: Tailwind v4's 4px step (--spacing: 0.25rem), not overridden. These are the steps the recipes fix. The four control heights change with density: each -comfortable token is the value its control token takes under data-density="comfortable".

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Badge horizontal padding, icon-to-text gap in buttons, label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and select horizontal padding; table cell padding (py-3 px-3).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Medium button padding; compact stat tile padding; first and last table cell inset.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Full stat tile padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter below lg and the vertical gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter from lg.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: h-control-xs: toggle chips and sm segmented items. 36px in comfortable density.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: h-control-sm / size-control-sm: sm buttons, icon buttons, sm inputs, selects and comboboxes, menu and list option rows. 40px in comfortable density.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: h-control-md: md buttons (the Button default), md inputs, selects and comboboxes in toolbars, FilterSelect, md segmented items. 44px in comfortable density.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: h-control-lg: lg inputs, selects, comboboxes and date fields (their default, a form row) and lg buttons in form footers. 48px in comfortable density.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area for anything clickable (WCAG 2.2 target size): sort headers, checkbox and radio targets (the 16px box sits in a 24px square), link buttons, the StatusSelect pill, readiness cells that are buttons.

tokens.name: control-xs-comfortable
tokens.usage: control-xs under data-density="comfortable": toggle chips and sm segmented items. Replaces 28px.

tokens.name: control-sm-comfortable
tokens.usage: control-sm under data-density="comfortable": small buttons, icon buttons, sm fields, option rows. Replaces 32px.

tokens.name: control-md-comfortable
tokens.usage: control-md under data-density="comfortable": buttons, toolbar fields and filters, risk-matrix cells. Replaces 36px.

tokens.name: control-lg-comfortable
tokens.usage: control-lg under data-density="comfortable": form inputs, selects, comboboxes, date fields and lg buttons. Replaces 40px.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: pageShell max width.

radius.note: Tailwind v4 default radii, not overridden in @theme.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Category chips, code chips, link buttons, tab tops, menu and list option rows, tooltips, the checkbox box.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, date fields, filter boxes, segmented options, toggle chips, card-variant choices.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, the segmented track, empty-state icon tile, popovers, menus and list popups.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Centred dialogs (ModalShell placement="center", ConfirmDialog), the sign-in panel, the command palette and the PDF viewer's message panels. Side sheets have no radius.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills (StatusBadge, StatusSelect), radios, dots.

shadow.note: Three steps. Light: tinted from ink rgb(22 32 46). Dark: black and stronger. Each shadow utility reads an --elevation-* variable, so it changes with the theme. No other shadow compiles (--shadow-*: initial); shadow-none still works.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, inputs, selects, buttons, the selected toggle chip and segmented option.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus (RowMenu), list popups (Combobox, StatusSelect) and tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Side sheets and centred dialogs over the scrim. Dark adds a line-coloured hairline so the dialog edge reads on a dark page.

font-weight.note: Only three weights exist: @theme resets --font-weight-*, so font-bold, font-light and the rest compile to nothing.

tokens.name: font-weight-normal
tokens.usage: Body text, meta lines.

tokens.name: font-weight-medium
tokens.usage: Buttons, labels, chips, inactive tabs.

tokens.name: font-weight-semibold
tokens.usage: Titles, table headers, status pills, active tabs and segmented options.

tokens.name: tracking-tight
tokens.usage: Page titles and the 32px stat figure.

tokens.name: tracking-wider
tokens.usage: Uppercase labels on the printed authorisation card (a paper-form replica) only; screens use sentence case and never need it.
